test.title: Learning an instrument as an adult

paragraphs.text: Many adults take up a musical instrument, but opinions differ about what helps them succeed. Music teacher Olga Petrova believes adults should practise for short periods every day rather than for hours at the weekend, because regular practice builds memory more effectively.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Psychologist Daniel Frost studies motivation. His research suggests that adults who join a group or band are three times more likely to continue playing after a year than those who learn alone, mainly because they do not want to let others down.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Composer Amira Haddad argues that adults are often held back by the belief that they are too old to improve. She encourages her students to record themselves each month, so that they can hear their own progress.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Petrova and Haddad both warn against choosing music that is too difficult too early. Frost adds that choosing an instrument that fits a person’s lifestyle, such as one that is easy to carry, also affects whether people continue.
paragraphs.label: D

document.title: Learning an instrument as an adult

items.quote: She encourages her students to record themselves each month, so that they can hear their own progress
items.prompt: recommends listening to recordings of one’s own playing

explanation.en: Haddad asks students to “record themselves each month, so that they can hear their own progress” → C.
explanation.kk: Хаддад оқушыларына «record themselves each month, so that they can hear their own progress» деп ұсынады → C.
explanation.ru: Хаддад просит учеников «record themselves each month, so that they can hear their own progress» → C.

items.quote: adults who join a group or band are three times more likely to continue playing after a year than those who learn alone
items.prompt: compares learning with other people and learning alone

explanation.en: Frost compares: group members are “three times more likely … than those who learn alone” → B.
explanation.kk: Фрост салыстырады: топта ойнауды жалғастыру «three times more likely … than those who learn alone» → B.
explanation.ru: Фрост сравнивает: в группе продолжают играть «three times more likely … than those who learn alone» → B.

items.quote: adults should practise for short periods every day rather than for hours at the weekend

explanation.en: Petrova advises “short periods every day rather than for hours at the weekend”. Frequent short practice is her view → A.
explanation.kk: Петрова күнде аз-аздан жаттығуды ұсынады: «practise for short periods every day rather than for hours at the weekend». Жиі әрі қысқа жаттығу — оның ұстанымы → A.
explanation.ru: Петрова советует заниматься понемногу каждый день: «practise for short periods every day rather than for hours at the weekend». Частые короткие занятия — это её позиция → A.

items.quote: choosing an instrument that fits a person’s lifestyle, such as one that is easy to carry, also affects whether people continue
items.prompt: mentions how practical an instrument is to use in daily life

explanation.en: Frost adds that an instrument that “fits a person’s lifestyle, such as one that is easy to carry” matters → B. Petrova and Haddad discuss difficult music in that paragraph.
explanation.kk: Фрост «fits a person’s lifestyle, such as one that is easy to carry» аспап туралы қосады → B. Сол абзацта Петрова мен Хаддад музыканың қиындығы туралы айтады.
explanation.ru: Фрост добавляет про инструмент, который «fits a person’s lifestyle, such as one that is easy to carry» → B. Петрова и Хаддад в том же абзаце говорят о сложности музыки.

items.quote: adults are often held back by the belief that they are too old to improve
items.prompt: says a negative belief about age can slow progress

explanation.en: Haddad: adults are “held back by the belief that they are too old to improve” → C. “Slow progress” = “held back”.
explanation.kk: Хаддад: ересектерге «the belief that they are too old to improve» кедергі болады → C. «Slow progress» = «held back».
explanation.ru: Хаддад: взрослым мешает «the belief that they are too old to improve» → C. «Slow progress» = «held back».
